short_bio: Federal prosecutor who served as special counsel investigating Donald Trump from 2022 to 2025.
biography:
Jack Smith studied at Harvard Law School and began as a prosecutor in the Manhattan District Attorney’s office. He later worked in the US Attorney’s Office in Brooklyn and headed the Justice Department’s Public Integrity Section.

From 2018 to 2022 he was chief prosecutor of the Kosovo Specialist Chambers at The Hague, which tries crimes from the Kosovo war.

In November 2022 Attorney General Merrick Garland appointed him special counsel to oversee the investigations into Donald Trump’s handling of classified documents and efforts to overturn the 2020 election. He resigned in January 2025.
